summary: Hoth Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K to report changing its name to Rocket One Inc., effective May 26, 2026, via a Certificate of Amendment filed in Nevada. No shareholder approval was required. The common stock trading symbol will change to RKTO on Nasdaq starting May 28, 2026. The CUSIP number remains unchanged, and no shareholder rights are affected. This is a routine corporate name/symbol change with no financial terms, deal structure, or special-situation event.
